scope: Third expedition objective: Spirit Relay; original Blender lantern and spirit; compact route selection and encounter labels.
behavior: Three route offers always contain gauntlet, ritual and relay, with deterministic oaths and preserved ritual offer placement.
Three registered guard deaths release at most one spirit each. Link carries one spirit while moving and attacking.
Health loss drops the carried spirit onto validated terrain with a thirty-tick recovery delay. Loose spirits return to the supported shrine after six hundred active ticks.
Delivery into any unlit lantern consumes one spirit without channeling. Three lanterns expose the warden; defeating all registered enemies earns one atomic cache.
Pauses suspend objective updates; retries, scene changes and run termination clear runtime spirits and deliveries.
Save section v9 reads versions 1 through 8 and retains earned caches without live combat actors.

All three objective buttons appeared with oath names and individually collapsed counters.
Expanded relay instructions independently and selected Spirit relay / Iron procession.
Resumed the normal adventure and observed the shrine, relay lantern geometry, four named enemies and Iron cleave warning in Hyrule Field.
